g.text: FUEL GAS, FLARE KO & UTILITY HEADERS
1. Branch destinations shown at header take-offs; individual consumer lines on referenced P&IDs.
2. Flare header slopes to D-104 (no pockets); all PSV discharges enter top of header.
3. D-104 pump-out by OSBL slop pumps on LIC-9003 (no unit pump in Rev A equipment list).
4. Steam / BFW / CW / IA / N2 flows are unit totals (H&MB + allowances stated in line list).
5. Line numbers: <NPS>-<fluid>-<area>-<seq>-<class>-<insulation> per CONVENTIONS; see line list CFU-000-PI-LL-001.
6. All vents / drains 3/4" min. with blind or cap; HPV/LPD to piping specification. Valve sizes = line size UNO.
7. Instrument tags per ISA-5.1; index CFU-000-IC-IDX-001. SIS functions per SRS (SIF tags shown in interlocks).
RELIEF SOURCES: PSV-1001, PSV-1002, PSV-1003, PSV-1004, PSV-1005, PSV-1006, PSV-1007, PSV-1008, PSV-1009, PSV-2001, PSV-2002
+ H-101 / H-201 FG DBB VENTS, D-102 / D-105 OFF-GAS (UPSET)
TRIPS: ALL UNIT XV / EIV, H-101 & H-201 BMS
